title: Advanced Grammar in Use
subtitle: A self-study grammar course for advanced learners
author: Based on Martin Hewings's Advanced Grammar in Use (3rd edition)
description: 100 advanced grammar lessons - reporting, passives, participle clauses, inversion and the fine distinctions that separate C1 from C2 - each followed by a playful quiz.
